packs.title: Linux for engineers
packs.summary: Navigate, secure, package, schedule and troubleshoot a Linux server the way production work demands.

packs.title: Git and version control
packs.summary: Track changes with Git: commits, branches, merging, rebase, remotes, pull requests, tags, hooks, large repositories, and recovery when things go wrong.

packs.title: Shell scripting
packs.summary: Write Bash scripts that fail loudly, run safely, parse JSON from APIs and replace repetitive manual work.

packs.title: Python for automation
packs.summary: Write Python scripts that handle files, processes, HTTP APIs and cloud SDKs, with tests and a packaged command-line tool.

packs.title: Networking essentials
packs.summary: Reason about addresses, DNS, HTTP, TLS and firewalls well enough to debug any connectivity failure.

packs.title: Docker and containers
packs.summary: Build small, secure images, run multi-container applications, and understand registries, runtimes and the OCI standard.

packs.title: CI/CD and delivery
packs.summary: Design pipelines that build, test and ship safely, secure the supply chain, and deploy with rolling, canary and declarative delivery.

packs.title: Kubernetes
packs.summary: Run workloads on Kubernetes from architecture and networking to Helm, autoscaling, operators, cluster upgrades, RBAC, troubleshooting and exam strategy.

packs.title: Terraform and infrastructure as code
packs.summary: Describe infrastructure as code, use advanced HCL, manage state and secrets safely, and build real AWS and Azure stacks.

packs.title: Cloud platforms: AWS and Azure
packs.summary: Core concepts side by side on AWS and Azure: identity, networks, DNS and CDN, compute, serverless, managed Kubernetes, security, monitoring and cost.

packs.title: Observability
packs.summary: Instrument systems with metrics, logs and traces, ship them with OpenTelemetry, probe from outside, and alert on what users actually feel.

packs.title: Site reliability engineering
packs.summary: Define reliability with SLOs, respond to incidents, run on-call, plan capacity, practise failure and manage change safely.

packs.title: DevSecOps and security
packs.summary: Build security into delivery: threat modeling, secrets, pipeline and supply chain checks, container and Kubernetes hardening, cloud identity and incident response.

packs.title: Ansible and configuration management
packs.summary: Describe servers in inventories and playbooks, keep them consistent with idempotent roles, protect secrets with Vault and roll changes out safely.

packs.title: Databases for operators
packs.summary: Run relational databases with confidence: SQL, indexes and plans, transactions, backups, replication, safe migrations, caches and incident triage.

packs.title: Go for DevOps engineers
packs.summary: Write small, fast, reliable Go services and tools: types, errors, interfaces, goroutines, context, HTTP, testing, containers and debugging.

packs.title: Helm for beginners
packs.summary: Package, configure, upgrade and roll back Kubernetes applications with Helm: charts, values, templates, releases, dependencies and debugging.

packs.title: Cloud security and IAM
packs.summary: Control who and what can do what in the cloud: identities, roles and policies on AWS and Azure, least privilege, secrets and keys, private networking, audit logs and debugging access errors.

packs.title: Kubernetes administration and operations
packs.summary: Run clusters, not only apps: control plane and etcd, backups, safe upgrades, RBAC, node maintenance, quotas and autoscaling, network and pod security, and debugging cluster faults.

packs.title: Continuous delivery with Argo CD
packs.summary: Deliver to Kubernetes by letting a controller pull the desired state from a repository: applications, sync and drift, Helm and Kustomize, environments, hooks, access and debugging.

packs.title: LLM fundamentals
packs.summary: Understand how large language models work in practice: tokens, context windows, sampling, training, API calls, cost, latency, evaluation and debugging.

packs.title: Prompting and structured output
packs.summary: Write reliable prompts, give examples, ask for step-by-step reasoning, get validated JSON back, and version and test your prompts.

packs.title: Claude Skills
packs.summary: Package expertise as skills Claude loads on demand: SKILL.md, descriptions that trigger, progressive disclosure, scripts, testing, sharing and security.

packs.title: Tool use and MCP
packs.summary: Let models call tools safely: function calling, the tool-use loop, the Model Context Protocol, building a server, permissions and prompt injection.

packs.title: System design for platform and SRE
packs.summary: Design systems that fail small: estimation, caching, queues, consistency, quorums, cells, shuffle sharding, load shedding, multi-region, change safety, and worked designs reviewed against real outages.

packs.title: MLOps: machine learning in production
packs.summary: Run models like any other production system: data checks, reproducible training, tested pipelines, a model registry, safe releases, serving, and monitoring for drift with a retraining loop.

packs.title: AIOps: algorithms for operations
packs.summary: Use statistics and machine learning to help run systems: anomaly detection, alert correlation, log and trace patterns, root cause hints, incident assistants and safe auto-remediation.

packs.title: AIOps in practice
packs.summary: Run AIOps safely: data pipelines, remediation tiers and verification, kill switches and audit, chaos tests, retrieval over runbooks, agents and approval gates, prompt injection, evaluation, build versus buy, failure modes and operations.

packs.title: Virtualization
packs.summary: Understand hypervisors, CPU and memory overcommit, virtual disks and snapshots, virtual networks and live migration, and troubleshoot a KVM host.

packs.title: Storage and filesystems
packs.summary: Choose block, file or object storage, manage ext4 and XFS, LVM and RAID, NFS, iSCSI and Ceph, and diagnose slow or full disks.

packs.title: KubeVirt: VMs on Kubernetes
packs.summary: Run virtual machines on Kubernetes: architecture, install, disks and CDI, storage and live migration, networking, performance, backup, operations and moving from VMware.

packs.title: Ceph and software-defined storage
packs.summary: Understand and operate Ceph: RADOS, OSDs and monitors, CRUSH and placement groups, RBD, CephFS, RGW, Rook on Kubernetes, performance, failure recovery and capacity planning.

packs.title: Vault and secrets management
packs.summary: Manage secrets with HashiCorp Vault: seal and unseal, auth methods, policies, KV, dynamic secrets, PKI, transit encryption, Kubernetes integration, high availability and incident response.

packs.title: SQL performance and database operations
packs.summary: Read query plans, add the right indexes, untangle locks, size connection pools and run replication, vacuum and day-two operations.

packs.title: GPU, AI infrastructure and LLM serving
packs.summary: Know what limits inference on a GPU, run vLLM, TGI and Triton, schedule GPUs on Kubernetes, and control latency and cost.

packs.title: OpenStack and private cloud
packs.summary: Run a private cloud: Keystone, Nova, Neutron, Cinder and Glance, quotas, scheduling, networking and day-two operations.

packs.title: Bare metal and datacenter
packs.summary: Rack, provision and operate physical servers: BMC and IPMI, PXE provisioning, disks and RAID, leaf-spine networking and fleet operations.

packs.title: Service mesh and Kubernetes networking
packs.summary: Understand pod networking, CNI and network policy, then run a service mesh with mTLS, traffic routing and troubleshooting.

packs.title: Reverse proxies and load balancers
packs.summary: Run nginx, HAProxy and Envoy in front of services: routing, TLS, load balancing, timeouts, caching, rate limits and debugging 502 and 504 errors.

packs.title: Messaging and streaming
packs.summary: Choose and operate queues and logs: RabbitMQ and Kafka, delivery guarantees, consumer groups, lag, retention, schemas and managed cloud services.

packs.title: CloudFormation and Bicep
packs.summary: Write and operate cloud-native infrastructure as code: AWS CloudFormation and Azure Bicep, change previews, stacks, modules, testing and debugging failed deployments.

packs.title: Google Cloud
packs.summary: Learn the Google Cloud model: projects, VPC, Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, GKE, Cloud Run, data and messaging services, operations and cost, with the gcloud CLI.
